y-m-49-06.title: Ubungqina obubhalwe ngabafundi abane: sesiphi isicatshulwa esabonisa u-S?
y-m-49-06.topic: Ubungqina besindululo (ubungqina nge-contrapositive, ubungqina ngokuphikisana, nokwahlula kwi-converse)
y-m-49-06.goal: Hlela ukuba sesiphi kwizicatshulwa ezine esamkelwa njengobungqina, uze ucacise ukuba isicatshulwa esinengqikelelo nesigqibo ezitshintshiselene sibonisa ntoni.
y-m-49-06.material:
Isindululo S malunga namanani emvelo a no-b: 'Ukuba ab ingqabangqaba, ngoko a no-b zombini zingqabangqaba.'
Abafundi abane ngamnye wabhala ukuba wabonisa u-S.
가: Ukuba a=3, b=5, ngoko ab=15 ingqabangqaba, yaye a no-b zombini zingqabangqaba. Ukuba a=7, b=9, ngoko ab=63 ingqabangqaba, yaye zombini zingqabangqaba. Ngoko S inyani.
나: Masithi enye okanye zombini kuka-a no-b iyipheyiri. Ukuba siliza elo nani lipheyiri ngo-2k (k linani lemvelo), ngoko ab inomenzi 2k, ngoko iyipheyiri. Ngoko ukuba ab ingqabangqaba, ngoko a no-b zombini zingqabangqaba.
다: Masithi a no-b zombini zingqabangqaba. Ukuba a=2m+1 no-b=2n+1 (m no-n ngamanani aphelele angu-0 okanye ngaphezulu), ngoko ab=4mn+2m+2n+1=2(2mn+m+n)+1, ngoko ingqabangqaba. Ngoko S sele ibonisiwe.
라: Masithi ab ingqabangqaba yaye a iyipheyiri. Ukuba a=2k, ngoko ab=2kb iyipheyiri. Oku kuphikisana nesicingelo sokuba ab ingqabangqaba, ngoko a ingqabangqaba. b ingqabangqaba ngendlela efanayo.
